UNIFORM REGULATIONS

What to wear, per operation

The crew has a look. Here it is, function by function.

Mehndi, 27th Night

Comfortable festive, greens and bright colours. Small night, easy dressing.

Verdict: keep hands free for henna.

Grah Shanti

Traditional, calm colours, morning-appropriate. Kurta-pyjama, saree, salwar, serene is the brief.

Verdict: peaceful planet energy only.

Haldi

Yellow or white, comfortable, and fully turmeric-proof. If it needs dry-cleaning, it is not haldi clothing.

Verdict: you WILL leave more yellow than you arrived.

Dinner, 28th

Casual or traditional, both work. Rich colours and a little shine if you fancy it, easy casual if you don't, just leave room to eat.

Verdict: dress for the food AND the photos.

The Wedding

Your absolute best traditional wear, plus shoes you can dance in until the dhol gives up.

Verdict: main-character energy is encouraged.
